aboutCompany.name: Hadid Technology & Software Development Company
aboutCompany.tagline: Innovation in technology, quality in service, confidence in the future
aboutCompany.intro1: **Hadid** Technology & Software Development Company is active in information technology, the design and development of specialized software, and modern digital solutions.
aboutCompany.intro2: With about **5 years of experience** and a broad, specialist, creative, and committed team, Hadid works to deliver smart, practical, and effective solutions for individuals, companies, institutions, and organizations using current technology.
aboutCompany.intro3: At Hadid we believe technology can drive business growth, higher productivity, lower costs, and simpler day-to-day work. Our goal is to design and develop systems that match customers' real needs and make their operations easier, faster, and more accurate.
aboutCompany.servicesIntro: Hadid designs, builds, and develops software and digital systems. Our main areas of work are:
aboutCompany.service1Body: Advanced accounting systems for financial management, recording income and expenses, account management, financial reports, and precise control of business activity.
aboutCompany.service2Body: Management software for companies, institutions, offices, and organizations to organize activity, manage information, speed up work, and improve administrative performance.
aboutCompany.service3Body: Dedicated software designed and built to each customer's needs, activity, goals, and working structure.
aboutCompany.service4Body: Helping companies and organizations move from traditional, manual systems to digital ones for greater accuracy, speed, security, and ease.
aboutCompany.service5Body: Technical services, new capabilities, performance improvements, and help for customers using digital systems effectively.
aboutCompany.visionBody: Hadid's vision is to become a trusted, leading company in information technology and software development, and to play an effective role in digital growth through quality products and innovative solutions.
aboutCompany.missionBody: Our mission is to deliver smart, reliable, efficient software that fits our customers' needs. We combine experience, specialist knowledge, creativity, and modern technology to turn complex work problems into simple, effective solutions.
aboutCompany.why1: **About 5 years of experience** in technology and software development
aboutCompany.why2: **A broad specialist team** in designing and building digital systems
aboutCompany.why3: **Experience building different software**, including accounting and management systems
aboutCompany.why4: **Custom solutions** matched to each customer's needs and goals
aboutCompany.why5: **Focus on quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction**
aboutCompany.why6: **Commitment to continuous improvement** of products and services
aboutCompany.commitment1: At Hadid, our customers' success is part of our own. We work to understand their needs precisely, use modern development methods, and deliver systems that meet today's needs and can grow with tomorrow's.
aboutCompany.commitment2: Our goal is not only to build software, but to **create digital solutions for the growth, progress, and success of businesses and organizations**.
aboutCompany.contactBody: For more information about our services, consulting, and custom software, you can reach Hadid at the numbers below.
aboutCompany.slogan: Hadid — where new ideas become smart solutions.
aboutCompany.footer: {app} version {version} — designed and developed by Hadid Technology & Software Development Company

settings.dangerZoneHint: Irreversible actions. Clearing server, offline, sales, or purchases data cannot be undone. Export a backup first if you may need the data later.
settings.clearArchivedHint: This will permanently remove archived records. This cannot be undone.
settings.clearServerHint: Deletes all synced records from the server (products, movements, customers, warehouses, and more).
settings.clearServerMessage: This permanently deletes cloud data under the app root. Devices that fetch from the server afterwards will get an empty dataset. This cannot be undone.
settings.clearOfflineHint: Deletes local products, movements, customers, suppliers, warehouses, employees, and related records on this device. Settings and currencies are kept.
settings.clearOfflineMessage: This permanently erases business data stored on this computer. App settings and currencies stay. This cannot be undone.
settings.clearSalesHint: Deletes all sales invoices, restores stock from those sales, and removes leftover cut pieces (adjustments / waste / remnants). Products and purchases stay.
settings.clearSalesMessage: This permanently deletes every sales invoice and linked stock movements on this computer. Product stock from those sales is restored, and leftover cut remnants (adjustments, waste, remnant products) are removed from the warehouse. Purchases and non-remnant products stay. This cannot be undone.
settings.clearPurchasesHint: Deletes all purchase invoices and inbound/opening stock, removes leftover cut remnants (adjustments / waste), then rebuilds product quantities. Products and sales stay.
settings.clearPurchasesMessage: This permanently deletes every purchase invoice, inbound purchase movements, and opening stock rows on this computer. Leftover cut remnants (adjustments, waste, remnant products) are also removed. Product quantities are rebuilt from what remains. Sales and non-remnant products stay. This cannot be undone.
settings.clearPurchasesDone: Purchases data cleared. Warehouse stock rebuilt.
